item.title: Your earlier game request can count as your yes
item.summary: Murph can use your own message from the last 24 hours in the game chat to act on a matching request, even if you wrote it before the change was proposed.
item.details: Your words must clearly ask for or agree to that exact change. Someone else saying you agreed does not count; after 24 hours, Murph needs you to say it again.
